text.text: No permanent foundations within 10 m of the high-water line. Planting and raised timber decks only.
Inner streets carry pedestrians, bicycles and two-wheelers at 15 km/h.
District rules: movement, the coast and services. Numbers refer to the rules below.
A public corridor runs from the streets to the beach every 60 m.
All parking sits in hubs within 200 m, a 3-minute walk, of any door.
Four-wheeled vehicles use only the ring road and the primary corridors.
Deliveries unload at the edge and go the last stretch by electric cart, off-peak.
Private cars, taxis and ride-hailing do not enter the district.
Fire, ambulance and police reach every street and path, at all hours.
